answer: Randomized admission terrace: each epoch, agents draw a verifiable random beacon and only those whose draw falls under a published quota may register, with the threshold recomputed each round so nobody can precompute eligibility. An attacker must run a full identity each epoch and lose the unselected ones, paying that cost repeatedly. Quota placement acts as a pigment marking selected slots, and each rejected attempt is a discarded pearl the attacker cannot recover.
